Rejects USDG/wsNET listing; requires decimals<=18, canonical mark-pool lookup and usable marks; changing mark pool/quote basis while totalShares nonzero reverts. Depth pool count bounded by source MAX_DEPTH_POOLS(8), duplicates and mark-pool duplication rejected, each source pool identity validated. No timelock proved; Desk controls authority.

Effective depth=min(submitted depth,source measured depth), halved if ownerRisk. Formula leverage=clamp(floor(9000*1e18/(3*sigmaHBps+200)),1.2e18,10e18), then nonzero Safe ceiling. slipBps=floor(1000*1e18/L), maintenance=slip+200. tokenCap=min(floor(depth*slip/10000),250000e18,nonzero safeCap); positionCap=min(floor(tokenCap/4),50000e18). Open uses freshness21600s/probe flag, existing-position and lending guards. Probe boolean and volatility submissions are keeper inputs, not autonomous proof that a token cannot blacklist/upgrade.

Tries full TWAP+spot source first; then spot-only; then zero, preserving twapLive=false. Quote derives margin credit, whole leveraged notional, rounded-up loan USDG, opening fee25bps and min units; no guarantee of execution. Lender oracle-credit fallback not equivalent to healthy token TWAP.
